For a good start to the ratoon crop, clean the stubble, fill gaps and plan irrigation and fertilizer right after harvest.
Key steps after harvest
Stubble: cut evenly at ground level so the new shoots come up evenly.
Trash / leaves: spread them evenly across the field; this can help retain moisture.
Gaps: fill the empty spots so the plant population is maintained.
Irrigation: irrigate on time after harvest.
Nutrition: plan fertilizer according to the soil and crop condition.

Sugarcane planting: land preparation and choosing setts | ganna.in
How many buds should sugarcane setts have?
Usually pieces with 2–3 buds are used.
Where should Granules be applied at planting?
In the root zone, at the start of planting, 8–12 KG / vigha (20–30 KG / acre), distributed evenly.
Home › Knowledge Centre › Sugarcane planting
Three things matter most for good germination: well-prepared land, healthy setts and even planting with the right moisture.
1. Land preparation
Plough deep and make the soil loose and level.
Arrange drainage so water does not stand.
Mixing in well-rotted farmyard manure / organic manure improves the soil condition; quantity as per local advice.
2. Choosing setts
Take fresh, disease-free setts from a reliable source.
Treat the setts if needed, as per local agricultural advice.
3. Planting
Place all setts at an even depth and cover them with soil properly.
Keep the moisture right at planting: neither too little nor too much.
Keep row and plant spacing according to the variety and method.

When should Immunity Gold be sprayed?

Immunity Sugarcane Special: drenching and spray for sugarcane
Immunity Sugarcane Special: dose, timing and method for early drenching (0.5–0.7 litre / vigha) and the 2–4 leaf foliar spray (250 ML / vigha) in sugarcane.
How much Immunity Sugarcane Special should be used?
For drenching, 0.5–0.7 litres (500–700 ML) per vigha; for the foliar spray, 250 ML per vigha (with Immunity Gold, 45–50 ML in every 15-litre pump).
When should drenching be done?
After the first irrigation, or 3–4 days after applying a weedicide (herbicide).
Can it be used with chemical fertilizers, fungicides and pesticides?
Yes, it can be used in the program with chemical fertilizers, fungicides and pesticides. If you are unsure about a specific combination, call first.
What should be mixed with Sugarcane Special in the foliar spray?
With Immunity Gold: 45–50 ML Sugarcane Special and 45–50 ML Immunity Gold in every 15-litre pump.
